question: Under the Rail Kaushal Vikas Yojana launched in September 2021, the Government of India has proposed to impart training to a total of 50,000 candidates over a ________year period.
solution:
The correct answer is __**three.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Rail Kaushal Vikas Yojana:-**

 
 
• It** **was launched in **September 2021** by the** Government of India **to provide training to candidates for employment in the** railway sector.**
 
• The program aims to train** 50,000 candidates** over a period of **three years.**
 
• The training will cover various skills such as **welding, electrical work, carpentry,** and other technical skills required for** railway jobs.**
 
• The program will also provide **soft skills training** to improve the **overall employability **of the candidates.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Indian Railways:**

 
 
• The largest rail network in Asia and the world's fourth-largest, covering vast distances across India.
 
• Operates a wide range of passenger and freight services, contributing significantly to India's transportation and economy.
 
• Established during British colonial rule, it plays a crucial role in connecting diverse regions and people within the country.
